name: eulogy
title: Eulogy
description: A memorial theme built like the order of service handed out at the door: the home page is the booklet’s half-mourning violet cover with the name reversed out in large roman capitals and two staples on its spine, and inside, black ink on white with violet rubrics and italic notes — black cloth and lilac after dark.

tokens.--font-serif: the one Times-like serif for everything: the name on the cover, capital headings, rubrics, italic notes and body text
tokens.--font-mono: code in page text, the only place the serif steps aside
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the small violet rubrics: part headings, headings in page text, Reply by, dates, tags and table headings
tokens.--tracking-name: letter spacing of the name in capitals on the cover and on the small booklet
tokens.--color-bg: page background (white stock by day, black cloth at night)
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, programme titles, names and menu links
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: the intro under a heading, places in the programme, the reply address, notes about people, post summaries and the footer
tokens.--color-accent: the violet (lilac at night) of rubrics, links, roles, programme times, list markers, a rule in page text, selected text, the current menu entry and focus rings
tokens.--color-rule: thin dividing lines: under the masthead, around the reply block, between posts and table rows, above the footer, the dot before the reply address, and the soft shadow at the cut edge of a table that scrolls
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--color-cover: the violet card of the booklet: the cover on the home page, the closed booklet beside inner pages on a wide screen, and the small mark beside the site name
tokens.--color-cover-ink: lettering reversed out of the cover: the name, the invitation line, the date and the venue
tokens.--color-cover-soft: the quieter lettering on the cover — time, address, what to wear, the venue on the small booklet — and the short rule above the date
tokens.--color-fold: the shadow of the fold down each booklet's spine, under the staples and down the edge of the small mark beside the site name
tokens.--color-staple: the steel of the two staples on the cover’s spine
tokens.--color-staple-shine: the light catching the middle of each staple
tokens.--shadow-cover: the shadow the cover casts on the page
tokens.--measure: width of the text column on pages, posts and inside the booklet on the home page
tokens.--measure-wide: widest the masthead, home page and footer grow
tokens.--cover-width: width of the cover on the home page; on a phone it is the width of the screen
tokens.--cover-ratio: shape of both booklets, width divided by height; a cover with more words on it grows taller
tokens.--staple: length of each staple on the cover; the small booklet's are a little over half as long
tokens.--time-col: widest the margin for programme times grows; a longer time wraps inside it
tokens.--hang: the hanging indent of programme and people notes, and the indent of lists
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of code blocks, the search box and focus rings
tokens.--space-2: small gap: under rubrics and between reply lines
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens and the gap between paragraphs
tokens.--space-5: large gap between sections and above the footer
